top_articles.title: Bitcoin Price Slides Below $79,000 as Binance Loses $5.8 Billion in Massive Hack
top_articles.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bitcoin Price Slides Below $79,000 as Binance Loses $5.8 Billion in Massive Hack

Bitcoin price fell below $79,000 as reports of a suspected Binance hack, with outflows of up to $5.8 billion, prompted Tether and Circle to freeze roughly $1.8 to $2.4 billion in stablecoins.

This post Bitcoin Price Slides Below $79,000 as Binance Loses $5.8 Billion in Massive Hack first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
top_articles.label: BEARISH
